basic_info.description: Opportunity knocks at 463 Oxford Street! Located in the desirable University Mound neighborhood of Portola, this 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath home offers 1,340 square feet of potential waiting to be transformed. With stunning views of the bay and a location that can't be beat, this property is perfect for those ready to bring their contractor and vision to life. Enjoy the proximity to McLaren Park, perfect for outdoor enthusiasts, and discover the fantastic dining options just minutes away on San Bruno Ave. Commuters will appreciate being approximately 30 minutes from SFO, with quick access to the Mission District (10 minutes) and the vibrant Cortland Ave in Bernal Heights (7 minutes).    This is a rare chance to create your dream home in a prime location with endless potential. Don't miss out!
